pipeline.name: SYSLAB Design of Experiments
pipeline.description: Design of experiments -> synthetic runner -> KPI calculator -> analysis. design-of-experiments turns a DoE request (factors, ranges, method) into experiment_design.json; synthetic-runner is a stand-in for the experiment runner and simulator and writes made-up time series for every run (not a simulation); kpi-calculator computes the requested target metrics of every run from its time series; doe-analysis works out which factors drive which metrics. The topology generator, the district-heating simulator and the lab test will be added as further nodes, replacing the stand-in.
